sections.chapter_title: General purpose direct memory access controller (GPDMA)
sections.text_helper: Section 19.3.6 "GPDMA triggers" in chapter 19 (General purpose direct memory access controller (GPDMA)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 937.
sections.section_content:
A GPDMA trigger can be assigned to a GPDMA channel x, via TRIGSEL[6:0]
inGPDMA_CxTR2, provided that TRIGPOL[1:0] defines a rising or a falling edge of the
selected trigger (TRIGPOL[1:0]=01 or TRIGPOL[1:0]=10).
[Table 102. Programmed GPDMA1 trigger]
